dialogues.jp: 「うーむ……まだ胃の中が甘ったるい感じ……」

チョコの芸術を腹の中に収めたあと、自室に戻
り適当に雑誌を読み、ベッドに転がる。
dialogues.en:
With the artfully created chocolate firmly in my stomach, I
returned to my room, and read a fitness magazine on my bed.
dialogues.text:
With the artfully created chocolate firmly in my stomach, I
returned to my room, and read a fitness magazine on my bed.

dialogues.jp: 明日は日曜日。マッタリのんびり眠れる。
dialogues.en: Tomorrow's Sunday. I have no curfew for then.
dialogues.text: Tomorrow's Sunday. I have no curfew for then.

dialogues.jp: 枕元に転がっている目覚し時計を手に取る。
dialogues.en: I rolled to my bedside and grab my alarm clock.
dialogues.text: I rolled to my bedside and grab my alarm clock.

dialogues.en: The second hand had stopped moving.
dialogues.text: The second hand had stopped moving.

dialogues.jp:
机の中から新しい電池をとりだしていれてみる
が、反応がない。
dialogues.en:
Even after putting in new batteries from my desk, there's
still no reaction.
dialogues.text:
Even after putting in new batteries from my desk, there's
still no reaction.

dialogues.jp: 今度、買ってこなきゃな……。
dialogues.en: I paid too much for this thing...
dialogues.text: I paid too much for this thing...

dialogues.jp:
手にした目覚ましの針を３時にして元の場所に
戻すと、俺はぬくい布団の中に潜り込んだ……。
dialogues.en:
I returned the clock to it's original position after setting
the alarm for 3 PM, and crawled under the futon covers...
dialogues.text:
I returned the clock to it's original position after setting
the alarm for 3 PM, and crawled under the futon covers...

dialogues.jp:
根性チョコを食って、適当にダラダラすると適
度に眠くなってきた。
dialogues.en:
After eating the "Perseverance" chocolate, I sluggishly get
ready to sleep.
dialogues.text:
After eating the "Perseverance" chocolate, I sluggishly get
ready to sleep.

dialogues.jp:
時計をセットしようと思ったが、秒針が止まっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
When I try to set the alarm clock, I notice that the second
hand has stopped moving.
dialogues.text:
When I try to set the alarm clock, I notice that the second
hand has stopped moving.

dialogues.jp: 電池を換えても云とも寸とも言いやがらない。
dialogues.en: New batteries didn't help the cause either.
dialogues.text: New batteries didn't help the cause either.
